page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Margin note in the left margin, beside the lines "fecto structa" to "gois.". Running head at top with page number 126.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: tuò auxilio sint: Turbat.e pacis gravis multa sta fit aureorum scutatorum mille, aut pœna capitis, si quis multam solvere non queat: vis omnis absit, non armis, sed judicio controversiæ disceptentur, facinora severè reprimantur: æris alieni solutio expediatur: in controversiis civilibus appellatio sit adjudices urbanos, quemadmodum receptum apud alios, qui cum civitate fœdus habent: qui in legationem ad senatum non consensere per agrum Collumanum & vicinum, in quibus ij, qui sunt prius nominati, fœdere hoc non sint comprehensi: fœdus valeat in annos xxx. Signatum anno M.CCCC.LXVII postridiè Nonarum Septembr. Præfecti duo, quod id expedire in initio videretur, in agrum Collumanum missi, Hillebrandus Brandus, & Sibrandus Ulverdi. Ita quies ibi parta: anno postero domus præFedus cū Ofter-gois & Wester-gois.fecto structa. Post hæc, cùm diffidia & turbæ crebrescerent rursus in Oftergoâ, flammâque eâ Westergoa quoque afflare-tur, scintillaretque passim odium factionum, & cum civitate Groningana multorum simultas ex invidiâ & metu glisce-ret, ne quid indè majoris exisseret mali, tandem

page.notes: Printed "Collumanum" in the text has a damaged initial letter; read as C. "Turbat.e" printed with a stop inside the word. Printed "M.CCCC.LXVII" uses C and V as printed, not reversed C. The margin note's first word is read as "Fedus" with a damaged F. "tandem" at lower right is a catchword. The faint "Digitized" line at bottom right is a digitiser's mark and is left out.
